advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Confirm canonical status comparison does not emit a spurious status mutation for lossy local statuses (blocked/cancelled) before the rebar-status: annotation label lands, matching the old Jira-shape convergence.
evidence: outbound_field_diff.py:301-307: `if "status" in canonical_remote: ... if (not _suppressed_by_inbound(...) and local_status != canonical_remote["status"]): changed["status"] = local_status`

Old differ compared in Jira shape: outbound_fields.py:433 `local_mapped = _map_local_to_jira_fields(...)` then outbound_fields.py:584 `if local_val != jira_val` where both are Jira status NAMES, so blocked→'In Progress' vs Jira 'In Progress' converged

_LOCAL_TO_JIRA_STATUS collapses blocked→'In Progress' and in_progress→'In Progress' (outbound_fields.py:94-103); _JIRA_TO_LOCAL_STATUS maps 'In Progress'→'in_progress' (inbound_fields.py:66-77), so canonical_remote status can never be 'blocked' without the annotation label

Convergence therefore depends entirely on the rebar-status:blocked snapshot label being present (inbound_fields.py:207-210 label precedence); the pre-label pass emits a status field the old path did not
outbound_field_diff.py:294-298: `local_pri = ticket.get("priority", 2)` compared with `!= canonical_remote.get("priority", 2)`
Old path mapped through `_LOCAL_TO_JIRA_PRIORITY.get(ticket.get('priority',2),'Medium')` (outbound_fields.py:141) so any unknown local priority clamped to 'Medium' before compare
_JIRA_TO_LOCAL_PRIORITY / _LOCAL_TO_JIRA_PRIORITY only cover 0-4 (inbound_fields.py:58-64, outbound_fields.py:84-90)
advisory.finding: Status is now compared in LOCAL shape, but the local→Jira status map is many-to-one ('blocked'→'In Progress', 'closed'/'cancelled'/'deleted'→'Done'). The old differ compared in Jira shape so a local 'blocked' whose Jira status is already 'In Progress' produced NO status field mutation; the new code compares local 'blocked' against canonical_remote status 'in_progress' and emits a spurious status change whenever the snapshot lacks the rebar-status: annotation label (the pre-label pass / label-add-failure window).
merged_from: Priority (and status/type) are now compared in local shape without the clamping the old Jira-shape mapping applied. An out-of-range local priority (e.g. 99) old-mapped via `_LOCAL_TO_JIRA_PRIORITY.get(99, "Medium")` to 'Medium' and converged with a Jira 'Medium'; the new code compares `local_pri` (99) against `canonical_remote['priority']` (2) and emits a phantom priority change.
scenarios: A local 'blocked'/'cancelled' ticket on a pass where the snapshot has not yet acquired (or failed to acquire) the rebar-status: annotation label
